title: Homestyle Dal Tadka (Ghee Jeera)
instructions: Pressure cook washed toor and moong dal with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles.
Whisk cooked dal until creamy.
Heat ghee, crackle cumin seeds, fry golden garlic slices, dry chillies, and hing.
Pour hot tadka over the dal, cover immediately for 2 minutes to trap smoke.
Garnish with coriander and serve with steamed rice.

title: Restaurant Style Dal Makhani
instructions: Pressure cook soaked black urad and rajma for 5 whistles until soft.
Mash lightly with a ladle to release natural creaminess.
In a handi, cook ginger garlic paste and tomato puree in butter until oil separates.
Add dal with broth; simmer on low flame for 25 minutes stirring often.
Finish with cream, white butter, and crushed roasted kasuri methi.

title: Panchmel Dal (Rajasthani 5-Dal)

ingredients.name: Mix of Toor, Moong, Chana, Urad & Masoor Dal

instructions: Boil the 5 mixed lentils with turmeric and salt for 4 whistles.
Temper whole spices, tomatoes, and dry masala powders in hot ghee.
Combine lentils with spiced gravy, simmer 10 minutes, and serve with baati or rotis.

title: Chana Dal Lauki (Bottle Gourd)
instructions: Pressure cook chana dal and lauki cubes together with turmeric for 3 whistles.
Prepare a ginger, tomato, and cumin seed tadka in ghee.
Pour tadka into the dal and simmer for 5 minutes. Nutritious, cooling homestyle meal.

title: Dal Palak (Spinach Lentils)
instructions: Cook toor dal with chopped spinach and salt for 3 whistles.
Temper lots of garlic, cumin, and chillies in ghee.
Fold into the spinach dal and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

title: Maa Chole ki Dal (Punjabi Langar Dal)
instructions: Boil split urad and chana dal for 4 whistles until thick and porridge-like.
Sauté onions, ginger, and tomatoes in ghee until glossy.
Mix into the lentils and simmer on low for 15 minutes. Pure langar taste.

title: Moong Dal Khichdi (Desi Ghee)
instructions: Roast cumin and peppercorns in ghee with hing and ginger.
Add rice, moong dal, 4 cups water, and salt.
Pressure cook for 3 whistles until soft and melting. Top with extra ghee.

title: Gujarati Khatti Meethi Dal
instructions: Boil toor dal with peanuts for 3 whistles; blend smooth.
Simmer with tamarind, jaggery, ginger, and spices for 10 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds, cloves, cinnamon, and curry leaves in ghee and pour over.

title: Udupi Sambar
instructions: Boil toor dal and drumstick veggies separately.
Simmer veggies in tamarind water with sambar powder.
Stir in mashed dal, temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil.

title: Tomato Pepper Rasam
instructions: Boil crushed tomatoes with tamarind, turmeric, and water for 6 mins.
Add freshly ground black pepper, cumin, and garlic.
Temper mustard, hing, and curry leaves in hot ghee, pour over and turn off flame immediately.

title: Dal Banjari (Smoked Chana Dal)
instructions: Boil chana dal and urad dal with cloves and cinnamon for 4 whistles.
Temper plenty of garlic slices and dry red chillies in smoking hot ghee.
Infuse with charcoal smoke (dhungar) for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Masoor Dal Tadka (Red Lentils)

ingredients.name: Whole Brown Masoor / Red Split Masoor

instructions: Cook red masoor dal for just 2 whistles (cooks ultra fast).
Temper with onions, tomatoes, green chillies, and curry leaves in desi ghee.

title: Dhaba Style Paneer Bhurji
instructions: Heat ghee in kadhai; sauté cumin and finely chopped onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic and green chillies, cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, pav bhaji masala, and salt. Cook until oil separates.
Fold in crumbled paneer and roasted kasuri methi. Cook 2 mins and serve hot.

title: Paneer Butter Masala (Makhani)
instructions: Blend soaked cashews with tomatoes into velvety smooth paste.
Cook puree in butter with ginger garlic paste and Kashmiri chilli until deep orange.
Add splash of water, paneer cubes, and simmer 6 minutes.
Stir in fresh cream, honey/sugar pinch, and crushed kasuri methi.

title: Kadai Paneer (Capsicum & Onion)

ingredients.name: Roasted Kadai Masala (Coriander, Cumin, Red Chilli)

instructions: Dry roast and coarsely grind whole coriander seeds and dry red chillies.
Sauté capsicum and onion petals on high flame until smoky.
Cook tomato masala, add kadai spice, toss in paneer and crunchy veggies.
Cook 4 mins on medium heat and serve with garlic naan.

title: Shahi Paneer (White Mughlai Gravy)
instructions: Cook cardamom and whole spices in ghee, add boiled white onion cashew paste.
Whisk in yogurt smoothly on low flame so it does not curdle.
Gently add paneer cubes, saffron milk or kewra drops, and white pepper.
Simmer 5 minutes for a royal velvety white curry.

title: Silky Dhaba Palak Paneer
instructions: Blanch palak in boiling water 2 mins and shock in cold water for bright green hue.
Puree with green chillies. Sauté crushed garlic and onions in ghee.
Add puree, simmer 5 minutes, fold in paneer cubes and fresh cream.

title: Dhaba Aloo Gobi Adraki
instructions: Sear potatoes and gobi in smoking mustard oil with cumin and ginger juliennes.
Add turmeric, red chilli, and salt; cover and steam 10 minutes without water.
Uncover, toss with amchur powder and fresh coriander until crisp.

title: Bhindi Masala Do Pyaza
instructions: Wipe bhindi completely dry before chopping to avoid sliminess.
Pan-fry bhindi in oil until 80% tender and remove.
Sauté onions, add dry spices, return bhindi and toss on high flame for 4 minutes.

title: Baingan Bharta (Smoky Roasted)
instructions: Slit eggplant, insert garlic cloves, and roast directly on open stove flame until charred.
Peel skin and mash smoky pulp.
Sauté onions, tomatoes, and green chillies in mustard oil; fold in mashed baingan and cook 8 minutes.

title: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
instructions: Boil baby potatoes for 1 whistle, prick with fork, and deep fry until golden crust forms.
Whisk curd with saunf, sonth, and Kashmiri chilli powder.
Pour into hot mustard oil, cook until oil separates, add fried potatoes and dum-cook 10 mins.

title: Malai Kofta (Melt in Mouth)
instructions: Shape paneer-potato mixture with raisins inside into round balls and deep fry until golden.
Cook smooth cashew-tomato gravy with butter and aromatic spices.
Place fried koftas on a serving dish and pour simmering hot gravy over just before serving.

title: Methi Matar Malai
instructions: Sauté chopped methi leaves with a pinch of salt to remove bitterness.
Cook cashew paste in ghee with cardamom; add boiled green peas.
Stir in sautéed methi and fold in rich fresh malai/cream. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Amritsari Pindi Chana
instructions: Boil soaked chickpeas with a black tea bag and salt for 5 whistles until soft.
Toss with dry spices: anardana, chole masala, amchur.
Pour sizzling ghee tadka with ginger juliennes directly over the chickpeas; simmer 8 mins.

title: Punjabi Tariwala Rajma
instructions: Pressure cook soaked rajma with salt for 5 whistles until tender.
Cook onion-tomato masala in ghee until glossy and oil releases.
Combine with boiled rajma, mash a few beans to thicken gravy, and simmer on low 15 mins. Pair with rice!

title: High-Protein Soya Chunk Curry
instructions: Boil soya chunks 5 mins, squeeze out excess water, and marinate in curd and chilli powder.
Lightly sear marinated chunks in pan 3 mins.
Cook spicy onion-tomato gravy, add soya chunks and 1 cup water, simmer 10 minutes.

title: Soya Chaap Masala Gravy
instructions: Cut soya chaap, fry in hot oil until layers puff up crisp.
Simmer in rich dhaba spiced tomato gravy with cream and kasuri methi.
Meat-like texture packed with 36g plant protein.

title: Rajasthani Gatte ki Sabzi
instructions: Knead besan dough with ajwain and ghee; roll into logs and boil in water 10 mins.
Slice cooked logs into gattas.
Cook whisked yogurt with turmeric and coriander in ghee; add gatta pieces and simmer.

title: Mushroom Matar Masala
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms on high heat until golden and water evaporates.
Add green peas and spiced onion-tomato masala with half cup warm water.
Simmer 6 minutes until gravy thickens; garnish with coriander.

title: Sarson ka Saag (Makki Roti Partner)
instructions: Pressure cook cleaned greens with ginger, garlic, and chillies for 4 whistles.
Mash greens with a wooden masher while whisking in makki ka atta.
Slow cook 20 mins; finish with a sizzling garlic-ghee tadka and top with fresh white butter.

title: Jeera Aloo (Cumin Potatoes)
instructions: Crackle generous cumin seeds and slit chillies in hot ghee.
Add boiled potato cubes, turmeric, red chilli, and amchur powder.
Toss on medium-high flame for 5 minutes until crispy edges form.

title: Kurkuri Crispy Bhindi Fry
instructions: Toss thin bhindi strips in besan, rice flour, chilli powder, and chaat masala.
Shallow fry in hot oil on medium flame until golden and shatteringly crisp.
Serve immediately as a crunchy side with dal chawal.

title: Lauki Kofta Curry
instructions: Mix squeezed lauki with besan and spices; fry small round koftas until golden.
Simmer in light spiced onion-tomato gravy for 8 minutes.
Add fried koftas right before serving so they stay soft and tender.

title: Paneer Lababdar
instructions: Simmer rich tomato gravy with butter and aromatic whole spices.
Fold in grated paneer directly into the gravy for thick luxurious texture.
Add paneer cubes and fresh cream; simmer 4 minutes.

title: Stuffed Bharwa Shimla Mirch
instructions: Stuff hollowed capsicums with seasoned potato-paneer filling.
Pan fry in mustard oil on low flame, rotating sides until charred and tender (15 mins).

title: Mix Veg Kolhapuri (Spicy)
instructions: Roast dry coconut, sesame, and whole spices into fiery Kolhapuri masala paste.
Sauté mixed vegetables in the spicy paste with 1 cup water until cooked tender.

title: Tindora / Kundru Masala Fry
instructions: Sauté sliced tindora in hot mustard oil with mustard seeds.
Cover and cook 10 minutes on low; add dry spices and fry crisp.

title: Aloo Matar (Homestyle Gravy)
instructions: Pressure cook potatoes, peas, and onion-tomato gravy with 1 cup water for 2 whistles.
Mash a few potato pieces to thicken the comforting gravy. Finish with coriander.

title: Paneer Tikka Masala (Smoky Tawa)

ingredients.name: Spicy Tomato Gravy with Kasuri Methi

instructions: Pan-sear marinated paneer tikka with capsicum on high flame until charred.
Simmer in buttery tomato-cream sauce for 5 minutes.

title: Chana Masala (Dhaba Gravy)
instructions: Boil chickpeas 4 whistles until soft. Cook rich onion-tomato masala in ghee.
Add chana with half cup water and simmer on low flame for 12 minutes.

title: Aloo Methi (Dry Winter Sabzi)
instructions: Sauté garlic slices and green chillies in hot mustard oil.
Add potatoes and fresh methi leaves; cook uncovered on medium flame until methi softens and potatoes turn crisp.

title: Dum Aloo Banarasi
instructions: Scoop out baby potatoes, stuff with crumbled spiced paneer and nuts, and deep fry.
Simmer in golden tomato-cashew-poppy seed gravy for 10 minutes on low dum.

title: Crispy Paneer-Stuffed Moong Dal Chilla
instructions: Spread moong dal batter into a thin circular crepe on a hot tawa.
Drizzle ghee, flip once, and fill with grated paneer and herbs.
Fold and serve with green chutney.

title: Mumbai Chowpatty Pav Bhaji
instructions: Boil veggies 3 whistles; vigorously mash on tawa with butter, onions, tomatoes, and masala.
Simmer 8 minutes with extra butter and serve with toasted pav.

title: Indori Poha (Jeeravan Masala)

ingredients.name: Mustard Seeds, Green Chillies, Curry Leaves

instructions: Rinse poha and drain thoroughly. Temper mustard, chillies, peanuts in oil.
Toss in poha with turmeric, salt, and sugar pinch.
Garnish with crunchy sev, fresh pomegranate seeds, and spicy Jeeravan powder.

title: South Indian Masala Dosa
instructions: Spread batter paper-thin on cast iron tawa; drizzle ghee until crisp and golden.
Place spiced potato filling in the center, roll into a cylinder.
Serve with coconut chutney and hot sambar.

title: Steamed Soft Idli with Sambar
instructions: Pour batter into oiled idli plates and steam for 10 minutes until fluffy and cloud-soft.
Serve dipped in piping hot vegetable sambar.

title: Crispy Medu Vada
instructions: Whisk thick urad dal batter with peppercorns and curry leaves until aerated.
Shape doughnut rings with wet hands and deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Classic Punjabi Aloo Paratha
instructions: Roll dough, stuff generously with spiced potato mixture, and seal carefully.
Roll out flat and roast on hot tawa with generous ghee until blistered and golden.
Serve with cold curd and homemade mango pickle.

title: Paneer Onion Paratha
instructions: Stuff rolled wheat dough with spiced grated paneer and onions.
Roast on tawa until crisp on both sides. High protein fuel for your morning.

title: Methi Thepla (Travel Friendly)
instructions: Knead dough using curd, methi, sesame seeds, and spices.
Roll thin and roast lightly on tawa with oil. Stays soft for days!

title: Gujarati Nylon Khaman Dhokla

ingredients.name: Mustard, Green Chillies & Sugar Water Tadka

instructions: Whisk besan with lemon juice, turmeric, and water; add Eno right before steaming.
Steam 12 mins in cooker without whistle. Pour sweet and tangy mustard tadka water.

title: Sabudana Khichdi (Vrat Special)
instructions: Soak sabudana until pearls separate easily without stickiness.
Sauté cumin, chillies, and boiled potatoes in ghee; fold in sabudana and crushed peanuts.
Cook covered on low 4 mins until pearls turn translucent.

title: Delhi Samosa Chaat

ingredients.name: Sweet Imli Chutney & Spicy Mint Chutney

instructions: Crush hot samosas in a shallow bowl; top with warm spiced chickpea curry.
Drizzle sweet tamarind chutney, spicy green chutney, and creamy dahi.
Top with crunchy nylon sev and fresh coriander.

title: Mumbai Vada Pav (Dry Garlic Chutney)
instructions: Dip spiced potato balls in seasoned gram flour batter and deep fry.
Slit pav, spread green chutney and fiery red dry garlic coconut chutney.
Insert hot vada, press down and serve with fried salted chillies.

title: Hyderabadi Veg Dum Biryani
instructions: Layer spiced marinated vegetables in handi, top with parboiled aromatic basmati rice.
Sprinkle birista, mint, saffron milk, and generous desi ghee.
Seal handi lid with dough and cook on low dum flame for 20 minutes.

title: Restaurant Jeera Rice
instructions: Crackle cumin seeds and bay leaf in hot ghee until deeply fragrant.
Add washed basmati rice, sauté 1 minute, add 2 cups water and salt.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles; fluff gently with a fork.

title: South Indian Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)

ingredients.name: Mustard, Urad Dal, Curry Leaves, Ginger

instructions: Mash warm soft rice; mix with fresh curd and a splash of milk so it stays sweet.
Temper mustard seeds, urad dal, ginger, and curry leaves; pour over.
Top with fresh crunchy pomegranate seeds.

title: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
instructions: Heat oil, fry crunchy peanuts, chana dal, mustard, chillies, and turmeric.
Turn off heat, stir in fresh lemon juice.
Gently toss with cold cooked rice until evenly yellow and aromatic.

title: Mumbai Tawa Pulao
instructions: On a wide tawa, melt butter and cook crunchy vegetables with pav bhaji masala.
Toss cooked basmati rice vigorously with the spicy buttery bhaji mix for 3 minutes.

title: Kashmiri Sweet & Nutty Pulao
instructions: Cook basmati rice with whole spices and saffron.
Gently mix in roasted dry fruits, sliced fresh fruits, and ghee.

title: Karnataka Bisi Bele Bath
instructions: Pressure cook rice, lentils, and mixed vegetables together for 3 whistles.
Simmer with tamarind water and freshly roasted spicy-cinnamon masala powder.
Temper crunchy cashews and curry leaves in hot ghee and pour over.

title: Matar Pulao (Green Peas Rice)
instructions: Sauté cumin, cloves, cardamom, and green peas in ghee.
Add basmati rice, 2 cups water, and cook for 2 whistles. Aromatic and tender.

title: Pudina Mint Rice
instructions: Sauté mint paste in ghee until fragrant; mix with basmati rice and 2 cups water for 2 whistles.

title: Tomato Bath / Tomato Rice
instructions: Cook spiced tomato gravy with whole spices in pressure cooker.
Add rice, pressure cook 2 whistles. Tangy and spicy south Indian favorite.

title: Old Delhi Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tandoori spices; pan-sear until charred.
Simmer smooth tomato-cashew gravy with butter and mild spices.
Add chicken pieces, simmer 8 minutes, finish with cream, butter, and kasuri methi.

title: Dhaba Style Chicken Curry (Tariwala)
instructions: Heat mustard oil to smoking point; sear chicken pieces until lightly browned.
Sauté sliced onions, ginger-garlic, and whole spices until dark brown (bhunao).
Add chicken, 1.5 cups water, and pressure cook for 3 whistles. Thin spicy gravy for rice!

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani

ingredients.name: Marinated Chicken (Yogurt, Fried Onion, Biryani Masala)
Long Grain Aged Basmati Rice (70% Cooked)

instructions: Marinate chicken overnight in spiced yogurt, ginger garlic, and mint.
Place chicken at the bottom of a heavy pot; layer fragrant parboiled basmati rice over.
Drizzle saffron milk, rose water, and ghee; seal with dough and dum-cook 25 minutes.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala (Smoky Gravy)
instructions: Sear chicken tikka in a smoking hot pan.
Cook spicy, tangy onion-tomato gravy with capsicum petals.
Toss chicken into gravy, simmer 5 minutes, finish with cream and coriander.

title: Kadai Chicken (Peshawari Style)
instructions: Dry roast coriander seeds and dry red chillies; crush coarsely.
Stir-fry chicken, capsicum, and onions in high heat with the spicy kadai masala.

title: Chicken Chettinad (Fiery Black Pepper)

ingredients.name: Roasted Chettinad Masala (Fennel, Pepper, Poppy Seeds)

instructions: Grind roasted spices with fresh coconut into thick Chettinad paste.
Sauté shallots and curry leaves in coconut oil, add chicken and masala paste.
Pressure cook 2 whistles until intensely aromatic and peppery.

title: Chicken Korma (Shahi Mughlai)
instructions: Cook whole aromatic spices in ghee, add chicken and sear lightly.
Stir in whisked yogurt and fried onion almond paste; cook on low dum until oil floats.

title: Tandoori Chicken (Air Fryer / Oven)

ingredients.name: Kashmiri Red Chilli, Ginger Garlic & Mustard Oil

instructions: Make deep cuts in chicken; marinate with lemon juice, salt, and ginger-garlic (first marinade).
Apply thick hung curd, mustard oil, and tandoori spices (second marinade).
Air-fry at 200°C for 18-20 minutes or pan-sear until charred and juicy.

title: Chicken Keema Matar
instructions: Sauté ginger garlic and onions in ghee until brown.
Add chicken keema, break lumps with a spatula, and cook on high heat 5 minutes.
Add green peas, tomatoes, garam masala, cover and simmer 10 mins. Serve with pav!

title: Chicken Saagwala (Palak Chicken)
instructions: Sear chicken pieces with onions and garlic in ghee.
Add blanched spinach puree and spices; pressure cook for 2 whistles.

title: Chicken 65 (Crispy South Indian)
instructions: Marinate chicken in spiced curd, egg white, rice flour, and red chilli.
Deep fry until golden crisp. Toss with tempered curry leaves and garlic.

title: Indo-Chinese Chilli Chicken
instructions: Sauté heaps of garlic, chillies, capsicum, and onions in a flaming hot wok.
Add dark soy, green chilli sauce, and cornstarch slurry.
Toss crispy chicken pieces until coated in glossy sauce.

title: Methi Chicken (Fenugreek Chicken)
instructions: Sauté methi leaves lightly to reduce bitterness.
Cook chicken with onion-tomato-curd masala; fold in methi leaves and simmer 10 mins.

title: Malvani Chicken Sukka (Dry Coconut)
instructions: Pressure cook chicken with turmeric and salt 2 whistles.
Roast coconut paste with Malvani spices until dark and fragrant.
Toss cooked chicken into coconut masala until completely coated and dry.

title: Chicken Shawarma Protein Bowl
instructions: Marinate chicken breast in cumin, coriander, paprika, and garlic; grill 6 mins each side.
Slice grilled chicken over fresh crisp salad with garlic curd dressing.

title: Kolhapuri Chicken (Fiery Red Curry)
instructions: Sear chicken in smoking oil, add roasted dark coconut masala and Kolhapuri spices.
Pressure cook 3 whistles. Extremely spicy and rich rassa.

title: Chicken Do Pyaza
instructions: Cook chicken with chopped onions until tender.
Add crispy onion petals in the last 4 minutes of cooking for signature two-onion texture.

title: Chicken Rezala (Bengali White Curry)
instructions: Slow simmer chicken in cashew-poppy seed curd gravy with dry red chillies and kewra water.

title: Chicken Sukka (Mangalore Kori Sukka)
instructions: Cook chicken in spiced tamarind broth.
Toss with freshly roasted coarse coconut mixture until dry. Pairs amazingly with neer dosa.

title: Chicken Malai Tikka (Melt in Mouth)
instructions: Marinate chicken in cream, hung curd, ginger garlic, cheese, and cardamom.
Pan grill or air-fry on high heat until charred spots appear and meat stays juicy.

title: Pepper Chicken Fry (Andhra Style)
instructions: Pan-roast chicken in coconut oil with heaps of curry leaves, garlic, and fresh crushed black pepper until dry.

title: Hariyali Chicken Tikka (Green Herbs)
instructions: Marinate in cilantro-mint-green chilli paste with hung curd.
Grill on skewers 12 minutes. Lean, vibrant, and packed with clean protein.

title: Chicken Lababdar
instructions: Simmer spiced chicken in luscious tomato cashew gravy with grated paneer for extra body.

title: Chicken Kali Mirch (Black Pepper Cream)
instructions: Simmer chicken in white cashew-curd gravy studded with coarsely cracked black peppercorns.

title: Honey Chilli Chicken
instructions: Toss crispy fried chicken strips in honey, red chilli paste, garlic, and vinegar.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and spring onion greens.

title: Kashmiri Mutton Rogan Josh
instructions: Brown mutton in smoking mustard oil with whole cloves and cardamom.
Add whisked curd and Kashmiri chilli paste, stirring vigorously on low heat.
Add fennel and dry ginger powder with water; pressure cook 5 whistles until meat falls off bone.

title: Champaran Handi Mutton (Ahuna Meat)
instructions: Mix raw mutton with sliced onions, whole garlic heads, raw mustard oil, and crushed whole spices.
Seal in clay handi or heavy pressure cooker; cook on low heat for 4 whistles without stirring.
Garlic heads soften into sweet buttery spread; meat becomes fork-tender.

title: Rajasthani Laal Maas
instructions: Brown mutton in generous desi ghee with lots of garlic.
Add Mathania chilli paste and beaten curd; pressure cook for 5 whistles.
Infuse with a hot piece of burning charcoal drizzled with ghee (Dhungar) for signature smokiness.

title: Hyderabadi Mutton Dum Biryani
instructions: Tenderize mutton with raw papaya paste and aromatic spices for 4 hours.
Layer with 70% boiled rice, saffron, and fried onions; seal lid tightly and slow-dum cook.

title: Mutton Keema Pav (Irani Cafe)
instructions: Sauté whole spices and onions until dark golden.
Add mutton keema, fry on high flame until fat renders.
Simmer with spices and coriander; serve with buttery soft pav.

title: Bhuna Gosht (Slow Roasted Mutton)
instructions: Continuous slow roasting (bhunao) of mutton in its own juices and spices until thick, semi-dry, dark brown masala coats the meat.

title: Railway Mutton Curry (Anglo-Indian)
instructions: Cook mutton and halved potatoes with vinegar, spices, and coconut milk for 4 whistles.

title: Mutton Sukka (Madurai Style)
instructions: Cook mutton until tender; roast with shallots, curry leaves, and black pepper until dry and spicy.

title: Kosha Mangsho (Bengali Spicy Mutton)
instructions: Marinate mutton in curd and mustard oil.
Caramelize sugar in smoking oil, brown onions, and slow-bhunao mutton until pitch dark mahogany.

title: Lucknowi Shami Kebab (Melt in Mouth)
instructions: Boil keema with chana dal and whole spices for 3 whistles.
Grind into ultra-silky paste on silbatta, shape flat patties with mint inside, and shallow fry in ghee.

title: Nalli Nihari (Slow Cooked Shank)
instructions: Slow braise mutton shanks with aromatic Nihari spices for 6 whistles.
Thicken gravy with wheat flour slurry and top with sizzling ghee tadka, ginger juliennes, and lemon.

title: Dhaba Mutton Curry (Homestyle)
instructions: Sear mutton with rustic spices, cook 4 whistles in pressure cooker with 2 cups water.

title: Mutton Galouti Kebab
instructions: Marinate velvety lamb paste with tenderizer, shape soft disc patties, and sear gently on a tawa.

title: Mutton Pulao (Yakhni Pulao)
instructions: Simmer mutton with whole spice bouquet garni to extract clear aromatic broth.
Cook basmati rice in the rich yakhni broth with ghee until grains stand tall.

title: Mutton Dalcha (Lentil Mutton Stew)
instructions: Cook mutton and chana dal with bottle gourd until tender; temper with curry leaves and tamarind.

title: Goan Fish Curry (Coconut Kokum)
instructions: Grind coconut with red chillies, coriander seeds, garlic, and cumin into a paste.
Simmer paste with kokum water; gently slide in fish slices and cook 6 minutes.

title: Bengali Macher Jhol (Mustard Gravy)
instructions: Lightly fry turmeric-salted fish in smoking mustard oil.
Temper nigella seeds (kalonji) and green chillies; simmer in light mustard water with potatoes.

title: Crispy Amritsari Fish Fry
instructions: Marinate fish in lemon, ajwain, ginger-garlic, and gram flour.
Shallow fry until crisp and golden. Sprinkle chaat masala.

title: Malabar Prawn Curry
instructions: Cook prawns in earthen clay pot with kudampuli and spices for 5 minutes.
Pour thick coconut milk and finish with hot coconut oil curry leaf tadka.

title: Garlic Butter Pepper Prawns
instructions: Melt butter in skillet, sauté minced garlic until fragrant.
Toss in prawns and cook on high flame for 3 minutes until pink and juicy.

title: Tandoori Pomfret
instructions: Marinate scored pomfret with tandoori spices and lemon.
Grill or pan-sear on high heat 5 mins each side until charred and succulent.

title: Kerala Meen Pollichathu (Banana Leaf)
instructions: Pan fry fish 2 minutes; coat in spicy shallot tomato masala.
Wrap tight in wilted banana leaf and pan-roast in coconut oil until flavors infuse deeply.

title: Hyderabadi Prawn Biryani
instructions: Layer spiced marinated prawns with parboiled basmati rice.
Dum cook on low flame 15 minutes so prawns remain tender and sweet.

title: Kolambi Masala (Dry Prawn Fry)
instructions: Sauté prawns with onions, kokum water, and fiery Malvani masala until dry and coated.

title: Fish Tikka (Ajwaini Fish)
instructions: Marinate fish in ajwain, tandoori masala, and lemon juice.
Sear in a hot grill pan for 4 minutes each side.

title: Irani Cafe Mumbai Egg Bhurji
instructions: Sauté onions and chillies in butter until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices, scramble eggs gently until soft and creamy. Serve with pav.

title: Dhaba Style Egg Curry (Boiled & Fried)
instructions: Prick boiled eggs, fry in turmeric-chilli mustard oil until golden blistered crust forms.
Simmer in rich spiced dhaba gravy for 6 minutes.

title: Kolhapuri Egg Curry (Spicy Masala)
instructions: Simmer fried boiled eggs in fiery dark roasted Kolhapuri coconut gravy.

title: Hyderabadi Egg Dum Biryani
instructions: Layer fried spiced eggs with parboiled basmati rice, mint, and saffron milk; dum-cook 15 mins.

title: Street Style Double Egg Roll (Kolkata)

ingredients.name: Sliced Onions, Green Chillies & Kasundi Mustard

instructions: Pour beaten egg on tawa, press flaky paratha on top until attached and crisp.
Roll with crunchy sliced onions, green chillies, and lemon juice.

title: Middle Eastern Shakshuka (Poached Eggs in Tomato Sauce)
instructions: Simmer spiced tomato, garlic, and bell pepper sauce in skillet.
Make hollow wells, crack whole eggs in, cover and cook 5 mins until whites set and yolks run.

title: Masala Omelette with Butter Pav

ingredients.name: Finely Chopped Onion, Tomato, Chillies, Coriander

instructions: Whisk eggs vigorously with chopped onions, chillies, and coriander.
Fry in sizzling butter in hot pan; flip and serve with toasted butter pav.

title: Egg Keema / Anda Ghotala (Surat Style)
instructions: Cook grated boiled eggs into spiced buttery tomato gravy.
Top with sunny-side up fried egg. A Surti street food icon!

title: Egg Roast (Kerala Style)
instructions: Caramelize sliced onions in coconut oil with fennel and pepper.
Toss boiled eggs until coated in thick dark jammy onion masala. Perfect with appams!

title: Egg Paratha (Street Kathi Style)
instructions: Cook paratha, lift edge and pour whisked eggs inside pocket or layer on top.
Cook until crisp on both sides. Hearty, filling breakfast.

title: Eggless Chocolate Fudge Brownies
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl set over simmering water (or microwave in 30s bursts).
Whisk in condensed milk, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth and glossy.
Sift in flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder. Gently fold with a spatula until just combined without overmixing.
Pour batter into a parchment-lined 8-inch square baking tin.
Bake at 170°C (340°F) for 22-25 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out with moist crumbs.
Cool completely before slicing into fudgy squares.

title: Moist Banana Walnut Loaf Bread
instructions: Mash ripe bananas in a bowl; whisk in brown sugar, melted butter, and a splash of milk.
Whisk together whole wheat flour, cinnamon, and baking soda.
Combine wet and dry ingredients gently, folding in chopped walnuts.
Pour batter into a greased 9x5-inch loaf tin.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 40-45 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Let cool on a wire rack, slice and serve with butter or tea.

title: Mumbai Ladi Pav (Homemade Dinner Rolls)
instructions: Activate yeast and sugar in lukewarm water for 5 minutes until frothy.
Knead flour, salt, and yeast mixture for 8-10 minutes until elastic and smooth, incorporating butter at the end.
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in volume.
Punch dough down, divide into 9 equal round balls, and place tightly side-by-side in a greased square pan.
Proof for 30 minutes, then brush with milk.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 18-20 minutes until golden brown on top. Brush immediately with melted butter!

title: Eggless Blueberry Streusel Muffins
instructions: Whisk yogurt, sugar, oil, and vanilla extract until sugar dissolves.
Fold in sifted flour, baking powder, and pinch of salt.
Toss blueberries in 1 tsp dry flour (to prevent sinking) and gently fold into batter.
Divide batter into a 6-cup muffin tray lined with paper cups.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 20-22 minutes until tops spring back when lightly touched.
Cool for 5 minutes and enjoy warm.

title: Bakery Style Desi Atta Nankhatai
instructions: Cream ghee and powdered sugar together with a whisk for 5-7 minutes until pale, light, and fluffy.
Sift in wheat flour, besan, sooji, and cardamom powder.
Bring the dough together gently using your hands without hard kneading.
Roll into small lemon-sized balls, flatten slightly, and make a cross slit on top with a knife.
Press slivered pistachios in the center.
Bake at 160°C (320°F) for 15-18 minutes until the base turns golden. Cool completely to crisp up!

title: Garlic Rosemary Cheese Focaccia
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, warm water, and olive oil into a high-hydration sticky dough.
Perform stretch-and-folds every 20 minutes for 1 hour, then let proof until bubbly.
Transfer dough into an olive oil coated baking dish and let expand.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and press your fingers deep into the dough to create iconic focaccia dimples.
Top with garlic slices, fresh rosemary, sea salt, and cheese.
Bake at 210°C (410°F) for 22-25 minutes until golden and crisp.

title: Chewy Belgian Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Whisk melted butter with brown sugar and white sugar until completely emulsified.
Add milk and vanilla extract, whisking until smooth.
Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt until a cookie dough forms.
Fold in generous dark chocolate chips.
Scoop dough balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 10-12 minutes until edges are golden while centers stay soft and chewy.

title: Eggless Molten Choco Lava Cake
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and butter together until silky smooth.
Whisk in warm milk and powdered sugar.
Sift in flour and cocoa powder; gently fold into a smooth batter.
Pour into greased ramekins dusted with cocoa powder.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for exactly 8-9 minutes until the sides are set but the center wobbles.
Invert onto a serving plate immediately and dust with powdered sugar. Spoon in to watch the molten chocolate lava flow!

title: Cinnamon Swirl Buns with Glaze
instructions: Knead soft yeast dough and proof for 1 hour until doubled.
Roll dough into a rectangle, spread softened butter, and sprinkle heavily with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll tightly into a log and slice into 8 round pinwheels using thread or knife.
Place rolls in a baking dish and let rise for 25 minutes.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 20-22 minutes until golden brown.
Drizzle warm rolls with cream cheese vanilla glaze.

title: Eggless Red Velvet Cupcakes
instructions: Whisk buttermilk, sugar, oil, vanilla, and red coloring until vibrant.
Sift in flour and cocoa powder; mix gently.
Add baking soda and vinegar together (it will fizz) and immediately fold into batter.
Divide into cupcake liners.
Bake at 170°C (340°F) for 18-20 minutes.
Top with whipped cream or cream cheese swirl.

title: Spiced Carrot Walnut Loaf Cake
instructions: Beat eggs with brown sugar and oil until thick and pale.
Fold in sifted flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Gently fold in grated carrots and chopped walnuts.
Pour into a lined loaf tin.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 35 minutes until a skewer tests clean.
Cool and serve with hot tea or coffee.

title: Authentic Flaky French Croissants
instructions: Knead chilled dough and encase butter block; laminate with 3 single folds, chilling between each turn.
Roll laminated sheet thin and slice into long isosceles triangles.
Gently stretch base and roll tightly into crescent horns.
Proof for 1.5 hours at 24°C until doubled and jiggly.
Brush gently with beaten egg wash.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 18-20 minutes until deeply golden, flaky, and caramelized.

title: Crispy Veg Potato Puff Patties
instructions: Sauté ginger, chillies, peas, and potatoes with turmeric, amchur, and garam masala to make savory filling.
Cut puff pastry sheets into squares and place a spoonful of filling in the center.
Fold diagonally into triangles, sealing edges firmly with a fork.
Brush with milk and arrange on a lined baking tray.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20-22 minutes until puffed, ultra-flaky, and crisp.
Serve hot with tangy tamarind chutney or tomato ketchup.

title: Old-School Tutti Frutti Tea Cake
instructions: Toss tutti frutti in 1 tbsp flour to prevent them from sinking to the bottom.
Whisk condensed milk, melted butter, milk, and pineapple essence until smooth.
Fold in flour and baking powder, then fold in colorful tutti frutti.
Transfer into a parchment-lined loaf pan.
Bake at 170°C (340°F) for 28-30 minutes.
Cool, slice into bakery-style rectangles, and enjoy with evening chai.

title: Tandoori Paneer Stuffed Calzone Bread
instructions: Toss paneer cubes and veggies in tandoori spices and sauté lightly.
Roll bread dough into a 10-inch circle.
Spread paneer filling and cheese across half the circle.
Fold the other half over and crimp edges tightly to seal into a half-moon calzone.
Cut 2 steam vents on top and brush with garlic butter.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 15 minutes until bubbly, golden brown, and crisp.

title: Eggless Dark Chocolate Ganache Tart
instructions: Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press firmly into a tart tin base; chill for 15 minutes.
Heat cream until steaming (do not boil) and pour over chopped dark chocolate.
Let sit for 2 minutes, then whisk gently until a glossy, rich ganache forms.
Pour silky chocolate ganache into the chilled crust.
Refrigerate for 2 hours until set.
Sprinkle with flaky sea salt and slice into luxurious wedges.

title: Basbousa (Semolina Coconut Cake)
instructions: Mix semolina, coconut, sugar, yogurt, and melted ghee into a thick batter.
Spread evenly into a greased baking pan.
Score diamond patterns with a knife and place a whole almond in each diamond center.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 28-30 minutes until golden.
Pour warm rose-flavored sugar syrup evenly over the hot cake.
Let syrup absorb fully before serving at room temperature.

title: Spinach & Feta Cheese Savory Quiche
instructions: Blind bake shortcrust pastry in a tart tin at 190°C for 10 minutes.
Whisk eggs, milk, cream, pinch of nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Layer sautéed garlic spinach and crumbled feta in the pre-baked tart shell.
Pour the egg custard gently over the filling.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 25 minutes until custard is set and golden.
Cool slightly, slice and serve with a fresh salad.

title: Cranberry Orange Zest Scones
instructions: Rub cold cubed butter into flour and baking powder using fingertips until pea-sized crumbs form.
Toss in dried cranberries, orange zest, and sugar.
Add cold milk and gently bring dough together into a round disc without overworking.
Cut disc into 6 triangular wedges.
Brush tops with milk and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 16-18 minutes until golden and flaky.

title: Rustic Artisan Sourdough Bread
instructions: Autolyse flours and water for 30 minutes, then fold in active starter and salt.
Perform 4 stretch-and-folds over 2 hours, then bulk ferment until airy and pillowy.
Shape into a tight boule and place in a proofing basket; cold ferment overnight in fridge.
Score the loaf with a blade.
Bake in a preheated Dutch oven at 230°C (450°F) with lid on for 20 minutes, then lid off for 15 minutes for a deep golden crust.
Cool for at least 1 hour before slicing to reveal open airy crumb.

title: Authentic South Indian Filter Coffee (Kaapi)
instructions: Add coffee powder into top container of the brass coffee filter; press down lightly with the pressing disc.
Pour boiling water over the disc and close lid; let dark aromatic decoction drip through for 10 minutes.
In a traditional davarah/tumbler, add sugar and 40ml of hot freshly brewed decoction.
Pour boiling, frothy full cream milk from a height.
Pour back and forth between dabarah and tumbler to aerate and build thick velvety froth. Serve piping hot!

title: Dhaba Kadak Masala Chai
instructions: Coarsely crush ginger, cardamom, cloves, and peppercorns in a mortar pestle.
Boil water in a saucepan with crushed spices for 3 minutes until flavors infuse and color deepens.
Add CTC black tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes on medium flame.
Pour in milk and sugar; bring to a rolling boil.
Simmer on low-medium flame for 3 minutes, letting the tea rise and fall twice for a rich, kadak body.
Strain through a sieve into cutting glasses or kulhads and serve hot!

title: Mumbai Tapri Cutting Chai (Adrak Elaichi)
instructions: Boil water with pounded ginger and cardamom for 2 minutes.
Add tea powder and milk together.
Boil vigorously on high heat for 3 minutes until aromatic and rich caramel in color.
Strain into half-filled cutting tea glasses and enjoy with Parle-G or bun maska.

title: Royal Kashmiri Saffron Kahwa
instructions: Boil water in a pot with crushed cardamom and cinnamon stick for 3 minutes.
Add green tea leaves and remove from heat; let steep covered for 3 minutes.
In cups, place saffron strands, slivered almonds, and honey.
Strain the hot amber tea into the cups.
Watch saffron release golden hues and stir gently. Sip warm for soothing digestive luxury.

title: Cafe Style Frappé (Cold Coffee with Ice Cream)
instructions: Dissolve coffee powder and sugar in warm water.
Add coffee mixture, chilled milk, ice cubes, and half the vanilla scoop into a blender.
Blend on high speed for 45-60 seconds until thick, frothy, and creamy.
Drizzle chocolate syrup on the inside walls of a tall glass.
Pour cold coffee in, top with remaining scoop of vanilla ice cream, and dust with coffee powder.

title: Iced Caramel Vanilla Macchiato
instructions: Add vanilla syrup to bottom of a glass, then fill glass to the top with ice cubes.
Pour chilled milk over the ice.
Slowly pour hot espresso or concentrated coffee directly over the center of the milk for distinct aesthetic layers.
Drizzle top generously with buttery caramel sauce.
Serve layered with a straw.

title: Bistro Fresh Lemon Mint Iced Tea
instructions: Steep black tea in 200ml hot water for 4 minutes; discard tea bag and cool completely.
In a tall glass, lightly muddle mint leaves with lemon juice and honey.
Fill glass with ice cubes and lemon slices.
Pour brewed chilled tea over the ice.
Stir gently and garnish with a fresh sprig of mint.

title: Summer Peach & Basil Iced Tea
instructions: Lightly muddle peach slices, basil leaves, and lemon juice with honey in a shaker.
Add chilled brewed tea and ice cubes.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Pour into a chilled glass over fresh ice.
Garnish with a fresh peach wedge and basil leaf.

title: Thick Punjabi Sweet Mango Lassi
instructions: Combine thick chilled yogurt, mango pulp, sugar, and cardamom powder in a blender or traditional mathani (churner).
Blend on low-medium speed for 30 seconds until rich, velvety smooth, and creamy (do not overblend).
Pour into earthen clay kulhads or glasses.
Garnish with saffron strands, chopped pistachios, and fresh mango cubes. Serve chilled!

title: Bhuna Jeera Masala Chaas (Spiced Buttermilk)
instructions: Blend curd, chilled water, roasted cumin powder, black salt, and ginger-chilli paste until frothy.
Toss in finely chopped mint and coriander leaves.
Pour into tall glasses over ice cubes.
Sprinkle a pinch of roasted jeera on top and serve after a hearty Indian meal for flawless digestion.

title: Pune Special Mango Mastani Thick Shake
instructions: Blend mango pulp, chilled milk, and 1 scoop of ice cream until super thick and luxurious.
Pour the thick shake into a large glass.
Top with a second large scoop of ice cream.
Crown with chopped cashews, almonds, tutti frutti, and a bright red glazed cherry.
Serve with both a spoon and a straw!

title: Shahi Royal Badam Kesar Milk
instructions: Blend soaked peeled almonds with 3 tbsp warm milk into a fine, silky paste.
Bring whole milk to a boil in a heavy pot.
Add the almond paste, saffron strands, and sugar.
Simmer on low flame for 6-8 minutes, stirring continuously so milk thickens.
Finish with cardamom powder and slivered pistachios.
Serve warm in winter or chilled in summer!

title: Banarasi Shahi Thandai
instructions: Soak almonds, cashews, poppy seeds, fennel seeds, peppercorns, and rose petals in warm water for 2 hours.
Grind into an ultra-smooth, fragrant spice-nut paste.
Whisk the paste with chilled milk and sugar until thoroughly dissolved.
Strain through a fine muslin cloth or sieve for a velvety texture.
Serve chilled over crushed ice, garnished with saffron and dried rose petals.

title: Belgian Chocolate Protein Power Shake
instructions: Add milk, protein powder, sliced banana, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and ice into a high-speed blender.
Blend for 45 seconds until thick and velvety smooth.
Pour into a shaker bottle or glass.
Stir in chia seeds and drink immediately for 32g clean post-workout protein.

title: Wild Berry Greek Yogurt Smoothie
instructions: Combine Greek yogurt, frozen or fresh berries, honey, flaxseed, and coconut water in a blender.
Pulse and blend until vibrant purple and creamy.
Pour into a glass and top with a fresh strawberry slice and chia seeds.

title: Old Delhi Masala Shikanji (Spiced Lemonade)
instructions: Squeeze fresh lemon juice into a glass; add sugar syrup, black salt, chaat masala, and roasted cumin.
Stir until spices and sugar syrup blend into a flavorful concentrate.
Fill glass with crushed ice and pour in chilled water or bubbly soda.
Stir vigorously with a spoon and garnish with fresh mint leaves and lemon wheels.

title: Fresh Lime Soda (Sweet & Salt)
instructions: Add fresh lime juice, sugar syrup, and both salts to a tall glass.
Add plenty of ice cubes.
Pop open chilled club soda and pour slowly over the ice as it fizzes dramatically.
Give a swift stir with a long bar spoon and enjoy instantly!

title: Ruby Hibiscus Rose Cooler
instructions: Steep dried hibiscus flowers in boiling water for 5 minutes until deep ruby red; strain and chill.
Stir in rose water, lime juice, and honey.
Serve in a glass filled with ice and fresh pomegranate seeds for a floral, crisp refreshment.

title: Malabar Sulaimani Spiced Black Tea
instructions: Boil water with cracked cardamom, cinnamon, and jaggery for 3 minutes.
Add black tea leaves, turn off heat, and steep for 1.5 minutes.
Strain into clear cups.
Add fresh lemon juice and fresh mint leaf.
Serve hot after a Biryani feast as the traditional Malabar digestive tea.

title: Golden Haldi Doodh (Ayurvedic Immunity Latte)

ingredients.name: Cracked Black Pepper (Essential for Curcumin absorption)

instructions: Warm milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in turmeric, black pepper, cinnamon, and a tiny dollop of desi ghee.
Simmer gently for 4 minutes until golden and deeply aromatic (do not boil hard).
Remove from heat, let cool slightly, and stir in raw honey.
Drink warm before bedtime for restful sleep and deep immune recovery.

title: Classic Sourdough Country Loaf
instructions: Whisk active bubbly starter with lukewarm water until dissolved in a large bowl.
Add bread flour and whole wheat flour; mix into a shaggy dough. Rest covered for 45 minutes (autolyse).
Sprinkle sea salt and dimple into dough with wet fingers. Perform 4 sets of stretch-and-folds spaced 30 minutes apart.
Allow bulk fermentation until dough increases by 50% with visible aerated bubbles.
Pre-shape into a round boules, bench rest for 20 minutes, then shape tightly into a banneton basket.
Cold ferment in the refrigerator overnight (12 to 16 hours) to develop complex sour flavor.
Preheat Dutch oven to 230°C (450°F). Score dough with a razor blade, bake covered for 25 minutes, then uncover for 20 minutes until deep golden with an open airy crumb.

title: Sourdough Rosemary & Sea Salt Focaccia
instructions: Combine flour, water, starter, and salt into a high-hydration slack dough.
Perform coil folds every 30 minutes for 2 hours until dough feels supple and elastic.
Generously oil a 9x13 metal baking pan with extra virgin olive oil. Transfer dough into pan.
Let dough proof at room temperature for 3 to 4 hours until bubbling and jiggly.
Drizzle olive oil over the top, press fingers deep into dough to create signature craters.
Top with fresh rosemary sprigs, cherry tomatoes, and generous flaky sea salt.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 25 to 28 minutes until top is blistered golden brown and base is shatteringly crisp.

title: French Baguette (Crispy Crumb)
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, and cold water; autolyse for 30 minutes before kneading in salt.
Knead gently and perform 3 coil folds during a 2-hour bulk fermentation.
Divide into 3 equal portions (approx. 280g each) and pre-shape into cylinders.
Rest 15 minutes, then roll tightly into slender 14-inch baguettes with tapered pointed ends.
Proof on a floured baker's couche linen for 45 minutes.
Transfer to baking stone or perforated baguette tray, score with 4 diagonal overlapping cuts.
Bake at 240°C (475°F) with a pan of boiling water on oven floor to inject steam for 20 minutes until crust is crispy and golden.

title: Italian Ciabatta Loaf
instructions: Mix flour, water, yeast, olive oil, and salt in a bowl to form an extremely wet, sticky dough.
Perform 4 sets of wet-hand stretch-and-folds every 30 minutes inside an oiled rectangular container.
Allow dough to double in size with huge air bubbles forming throughout the structure.
Generously dust work surface with flour and semolina. Gently tip dough out without deflating bubbles.
Cut into 2 rectangular slippers ('ciabatta'), transfer carefully onto parchment paper.
Bake on a preheated pizza stone at 230°C (450°F) with steam for 22 minutes until hollow-sounding when tapped.

title: Japanese Shokupan (Milk Bread)
instructions: Cook 20g flour and 100ml water over low heat until thickened into gelatinous tangzhong; cool down.
Knead flour, milk, sugar, yeast, salt, and tangzhong in a stand mixer for 8 minutes.
Incorporate softened butter gradually and knead until the dough passes the translucent windowpane test.
Proof in a warm spot for 1 hour until doubled. Divide into 3 equal balls and rest 15 minutes.
Roll each ball into an oval, fold sides into center, roll tightly into a cylinder, and place in a Pullman loaf tin.
Proof until dough reaches 85% of tin height. Brush top with milk wash.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 30 minutes. Let cool on a rack to experience feather-light pillowy texture.

title: Golden Brioche Loaf
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, salt, yeast, and milk in a mixer bowl. Knead for 7 minutes on medium-low.
Gradually add cold butter piece-by-piece, ensuring each piece is fully emulsified before adding the next.
Knead for another 10 to 12 minutes until silky, elastic, and glossy.
Chill dough covered in the refrigerator overnight (8 to 12 hours) to firm the high butter content.
Divide chilled dough into 6 equal portions, roll into smooth spheres, and arrange side-by-side in a loaf tin.
Proof at room temperature for 2 hours until tripled in volume and bouncy.
Brush gently with milk wash and bake at 180°C (355°F) for 32 minutes until deep amber golden.

title: New York Everything Bagels

ingredients.name: Everything Bagel Seasoning (sesame, poppy, garlic, onion, salt)

instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, malt syrup, and warm water into a stiff, low-hydration dough. Knead vigorously for 10 minutes.
Rest dough covered for 1 hour until puffed. Divide into 6 equal 120g balls.
Poke a thumb through the center of each ball and twirl around fingers to stretch a 2-inch hole.
Bring a wide pot of water to boil with 1 tablespoon of barley malt syrup and 1 tsp baking soda.
Poach bagels for 60 seconds on each side; lift with slotted spoon and drain briefly.
Immediately dip boiled bagels generously into Everything Bagel seasoning on both sides.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 18 to 20 minutes until crisp, glossy, and authentically chewy.

title: Mediterranean Fluffy Pita Bread
instructions: Combine warm water, sugar, and yeast; let foam for 5 minutes. Stir in olive oil.
Add flour and salt, kneading into a smooth and soft dough for 7 minutes.
Cover and let rise in a warm spot for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Divide into 8 balls. Cover with a damp cloth and rest for 15 minutes.
Roll each ball into a 7-inch disc of 1/4-inch uniform thickness.
Cook in a screaming hot cast iron skillet or 250°C oven for 2 minutes until it balloons into a hollow pocket.
Wrap freshly baked hot pitas in a clean kitchen towel to keep them soft and pliable.

title: Garlic & Herb Pull-Apart Bread
instructions: Knead bread flour, milk, yeast, and salt into a soft dough and let rise for 1 hour.
Mix melted butter with minced garlic, chopped parsley, oregano, and black pepper.
Roll out dough into a large 12x18 inch rectangle. Brush generously with garlic butter and sprinkle shredded mozzarella.
Cut dough into small squares (around 3x3 inches).
Stack the squares horizontally into a greased loaf tin like files in a folder.
Proof for 30 minutes until puffy.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 28 to 30 minutes until golden brown with molten cheesy herb pull-apart layers.

title: Cinnamon Raisin Swirl Bread
instructions: Knead flour, warm milk, yeast, butter, and salt into a supple dough; fold in drained raisins.
First rise for 1 hour until doubled. Roll out dough into a 9x15 inch rectangle.
Brush surface with melted butter and sprinkle heavily with brown sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Roll tightly from the short edge into a snug log, pinch seams securely.
Transfer into a greased loaf pan and let rise until crowning 1 inch over the rim.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35 minutes until golden brown.
Cool completely before slicing to reveal dramatic fragrant cinnamon swirls.

title: Multigrain Seeded Sourdough
instructions: Toast seeds lightly and soak in 50ml warm water for 30 minutes (soaker).
Mix flours, sourdough starter, and water. Autolyse for 45 minutes.
Add salt and fold in soaked seed mixture evenly through 4 sets of stretch-and-folds.
Ferment for 4 hours at room temperature, then shape into an oval batard.
Roll exterior damp dough over raw sunflower and sesame seeds for a crunchy seeded crust.
Cold retard in fridge for 14 hours. Bake in covered Dutch oven at 230°C for 25 mins, uncovered for 20 mins.

title: Dutch Crunch Tiger Bread
instructions: Prepare a classic white bread dough with flour, water, yeast, and salt. Knead and rest for 1 hour.
Shape into 2 oval loaves or 6 round sandwich rolls and proof for 30 minutes.
Make tiger paste by whisking rice flour, warm water, yeast, sugar, salt, and sesame oil into thick paint.
Brush a generous thick layer of rice flour paste completely over the proofed rolls.
Bake at 200°C (390°F) for 25 minutes. As bread expands, rice flour topping cracks into a mottled, crispy tiger-skin crunch.

title: Traditional Irish Soda Bread
instructions: Sift flours, baking soda, and salt together in a large wide mixing bowl.
Make a well in the center and pour in fresh buttermilk.
Use a wooden spoon or fingers claw-like to quickly bring dough together without over-kneading.
Form gently into a round dome loaf and place onto a dusted baking sheet.
Slash a deep traditional cross across the top with a sharp knife to let the fairies out.
Sprinkle rolled oats and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 35 minutes until the bottom sounds hollow when tapped.

title: Parker House Butter Dinner Rolls
instructions: Knead flour, milk, half of the butter, sugar, and yeast into a silky, soft enriched dough.
Allow dough to rise for 1 hour until puffy and double.
Roll dough out to 1/2-inch thickness and cut into 3-inch rounds with a biscuit cutter.
Brush each round with melted butter, crease off-center, and fold over onto itself (classic Parker pocket shape).
Nestle closely in a buttered baking dish and proof for 30 minutes.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 18 minutes until golden. Brush with remaining hot butter and flaky salt.

title: Cheesy Stuffed Garlic Breadsticks
instructions: Knead flour, warm water, yeast, and salt into an elastic pizza-style dough. Rest 45 minutes.
Roll dough into a 10x12 inch rectangle. Place shredded mozzarella cheese down the center.
Fold sides over tightly to encase cheese and pinch edges to seal.
Transfer to baking tray. Make shallow crosswise slits every 1.5 inches.
Slather generously with garlic butter and sprinkle Italian seasoning.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 15 minutes until bubbly golden brown with epic molten cheese pulls.

title: Classic French Butter Croissant
instructions: Knead dough (détrempe) using flour, water, milk, sugar, yeast, and salt until smooth. Flatten into a rectangle and chill 2 hours.
Pound cold European butter between parchment sheets into an even 7x7 inch square butter block (beurrage).
Roll détrempe into a 10x10 inch diamond, place butter block diagonally, and fold corners envelope-style to lock in butter.
Perform a double turn (book fold), wrap in cling film, and chill in refrigerator for 45 minutes.
Roll out again and perform a single turn (letter fold). Chill for another 1 hour.
Roll laminated dough to 4mm thickness. Cut elongated triangles, stretch base gently, and roll from base to tip into crescent shapes.
Proof croissants at 26°C (avoid melting butter) for 2 to 2.5 hours until visibly jiggly with separated layers.
Gently brush with milk wash and bake at 200°C (390°F) for 18 to 20 minutes until deeply bronzed and flaky with open honeycomb crumb.

title: Pain au Chocolat (Chocolate Batons)
instructions: Roll rested laminated croissant dough to 3.5mm thickness.
Trim edges and cut into uniform 8x12 cm rectangles.
Place one chocolate baton 1 cm from the edge, fold dough over baton.
Place the second chocolate baton against the fold, and roll completely to encase both batons with seam on the bottom.
Proof on parchment paper at 25-27°C for 2 hours until aerated and wobbling.
Brush lightly with milk wash.
Bake at 195°C (385°F) for 18 minutes until crisp, caramelized golden brown with molten chocolate pockets.

title: Almond Frangipane Twice-Baked Croissant

ingredients.name: Milk and Cornstarch (egg substitute for cream)
Simple Sugar Syrup (scented with orange blossom)

instructions: Beat butter, powdered sugar, almond flour, milk slurry, and almond extract into smooth frangipane cream.
Slice day-old croissants horizontally in half.
Dip or brush both inner sides generously with fragrant warm sugar syrup.
Spread 2 generous tablespoons of almond frangipane cream inside and sandwich together.
Pipe an additional ribbon of frangipane across the top crust and press sliced almonds into cream.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 15 minutes until frangipane is set, golden, and edges are caramelized.
Dust lavishly with powdered sugar before serving warm.

title: Pistachio & Cardamom Cream Croissant
instructions: Whisk pistachio paste with mascarpone, cardamom, and powdered sugar until creamy; fold in whipped cream.
Poke two holes into the bottom or side of fresh croissants using a skewer or chopstick.
Pipe silky pistachio diplomat cream generously into the internal honeycomb chambers until heavy.
Dip the top of croissant into melted white chocolate tinted with a swirl of pistachio cream.
Garnish generously with finely crushed Iranian emerald pistachios and edible rose petals.
Chill for 15 minutes to set chocolate, then serve.

title: Cinnamon Morning Buns (Croissant Dough)
instructions: Roll laminated croissant dough to a rectangle. Brush surface with melted butter.
Sprinkle brown sugar, fragrant cinnamon, and freshly grated orange zest evenly across dough.
Roll dough tightly into a log, trim ends, and slice into 1.5-inch thick spirals.
Place each spiral cut-side down into a well-buttered muffin tin.
Proof for 1.5 to 2 hours until dough expands to fill each cup.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 22 minutes until deep golden and bubbling with caramel.
Immediately invert hot buns and roll generously in orange cinnamon sugar while warm.

title: Breton Kouign-Amann (Caramelized Pastry)
instructions: Prepare a simple bread dough, rest 1 hour, and chill.
Laminate dough with cold salted butter performing one book fold.
For the final letter folds, dust work surface and dough lavishly with granulated sugar instead of flour.
Roll dough out into a square, cut into 12 smaller squares.
Fold the four corners of each square into the center like an envelope.
Drop into buttered pastry rings dusted with sugar.
Bake at 200°C (390°F) for 22 minutes until the sugar melts into a crunchy, glassy amber caramel casing.

title: Fresh Berry Custard Danish Pastry
instructions: Roll laminated dough and cut into 10x10 cm squares.
Cut diagonal L-shaped slits in opposite corners, fold strips over the center to form a diamond cradle.
Proof for 1.5 hours until light and puffy.
Depress center and dollop a generous spoonful of thick vanilla bean custard.
Top with fresh blueberries and raspberries.
Bake at 200°C (390°F) for 18 minutes until fluted golden brown.
Brush warm apricot jam glaze over fruit and pastry for high-gloss bakery shine.

title: Savory Mushroom & Gruyère Croissant
instructions: Sauté sliced mushrooms in butter with garlic and thyme until browned and moisture evaporates.
Stir half of the sautéed mushrooms into rich, nutmeg-scented bechamel sauce.
Slice croissants horizontally and spread mushroom bechamel generously inside.
Layer with shredded nutty Gruyère cheese and close croissants.
Top croissants with a spoonful of bechamel, extra mushrooms, and more Gruyère cheese.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 12 minutes until bubbly, gratinéed, and irresistibly savory.

title: Pain aux Raisins (Escargot Pastry)
instructions: Plump raisins in warm water for 20 minutes and drain thoroughly.
Roll croissant dough into a neat 10x16 inch sheet.
Spread an even layer of smooth vanilla pastry cream over the surface, leaving 1 cm top edge clean.
Scatter plump raisins evenly across the pastry cream.
Roll from bottom edge into a neat log and chill for 20 minutes to firm up.
Slice into 1-inch thick pinwheels, place on baking sheet, and proof for 1.5 hours.
Bake at 195°C (385°F) for 20 minutes until golden, then glaze with warm simple syrup.

title: Cruffin (Cinnamon Sugar Croissant Muffin)

ingredients.name: Vanilla Pastry Cream or Nutella for filling

instructions: Roll laminated croissant dough thin and cut into long strips.
Brush with soft butter, sprinkle lightly with cinnamon sugar, and roll into a tight spiral cylinder.
Slice each cylinder lengthwise to expose the numerous buttery flaky layers.
Knot the cut dough strip into a tall rose shape with layered edges facing outward.
Drop into deep buttered muffin cups and proof for 2 hours until overflowing.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 22 minutes until deep golden and tall.
Roll immediately in cinnamon sugar, pipe vanilla cream or Nutella into the center.

title: Classic New York Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Mix biscuit crumbs with melted butter and press firmly into base and sides of an 8-inch springform pan. Pre-bake at 170°C for 10 minutes.
Beat softened cream cheese and sugar on low speed until perfectly smooth without incorporating excess air.
Blend in sour cream, heavy cream, cornstarch, vanilla bean paste, lemon juice, and zest.
Wrap outside of springform pan in heavy-duty aluminum foil to water-proof.
Pour filling over pre-baked crust, place pan inside a larger roasting tray filled with 1 inch of boiling water (water bath).
Bake at 150°C (300°F) for 65 minutes until edges are set but center still has a slight wobble.
Turn off oven, prop door open 1 inch, and let cool inside for 1 hour to prevent cracks.
Chill in refrigerator for at least 8 hours before unmolding and slicing cleanly with a warm knife.

title: San Sebastián Basque Burnt Cheesecake
instructions: Line an 8-inch cake pan with two overlapping sheets of crumpled wet parchment paper, letting edges hang over.
Beat cream cheese and caster sugar on medium speed until smooth and sugar dissolves.
Stream in heavy cream slowly while whisking continuously.
Sift in flour and salt, folding until completely homogenous and silky smooth.
Pour batter into the prepared parchment-lined pan and tap lightly on the counter to release air bubbles.
Bake at 230°C (450°F) for 32 to 35 minutes until the top is deeply caramelized mahogany dark brown and puffed, while the center is very jiggly.
Cool completely at room temperature for 4 hours. The center will settle into a decadent, molten custardy texture.

title: Lotus Biscoff Speculoos Cheesecake (No-Bake)
instructions: Crush 200g Biscoff biscuits into fine sand, mix with melted butter, and press firmly into an 8-inch springform pan. Chill 30 minutes.
Whip heavy cream with powdered sugar to stiff peaks; set aside.
In a separate bowl, beat cream cheese and 150g warmed Biscoff spread until smooth and velvety.
Gently fold whipped cream into the Biscoff cream cheese mixture in two additions.
Spoon filling over the chilled crust and smooth top flat with an offset spatula.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours (or overnight) until firm.
Melt remaining 100g Biscoff spread until pourable and pour over cheesecake, tilting pan to cover evenly.
Garnish border with crushed Biscoff crumbs and whole biscuits.

title: Japanese Cotton Fluffy Soufflé Cheesecake
instructions: Melt cream cheese, butter, and milk over a warm double boiler until smooth; let cool slightly.
Sift in cake flour and cornstarch, whisking until lump-free. Add lemon juice and vanilla.
Whip foam/meringue with caster sugar until soft, glossy peaks form.
Fold 1/3 of the meringue into cream cheese batter to lighten, then gently fold in remaining meringue without deflating.
Pour into a parchment-lined 7-inch round pan.
Bake in a water bath at 150°C for 30 minutes, then reduce to 130°C for 45 minutes.
Let sit in turned-off oven with door ajar for 15 minutes to enjoy melt-in-mouth cloud soufflé texture.

title: Wild Blueberry Swirl Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Simmer blueberries, 30g sugar, and lemon juice until berries burst; blend and strain into a glossy thick coulis.
Beat cream cheese, remaining sugar, and sour cream with cornstarch until silky.
Pour cheesecake batter into pre-baked graham crust.
Dollop circles of blueberry compote across the surface.
Drag a toothpick or skewer in gentle figure-eight motions to create elegant marble swirls.
Bake in a water bath at 155°C (310°F) for 55 minutes.
Cool slowly and refrigerate overnight for luscious blueberry cream perfection.

title: Alphonso Mango Cream Cheesecake (No-Bake)
instructions: Prepare biscuit crust in springform pan and chill.
Dissolve agar agar in 40ml warm water, simmer 1 minute, and stir into 150g mango pulp.
Beat cream cheese, powdered sugar, and mango-agar mixture until smooth; fold in whipped cream.
Pour mango cream cheese filling over crust and chill for 2 hours.
For top jelly layer, heat remaining 150g mango pulp with 0.5 tsp agar agar, cool slightly, and pour over set cheesecake.
Chill for 4 hours until completely set.
Decorate top with fresh diced Alphonso mango cubes and fresh mint leaves.

title: Dark Chocolate Ganache Basque Cheesecake
instructions: Line cake pan with crumpled parchment paper.
Melt dark chocolate with 50ml warm heavy cream until glossy.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until creamy. Mix in melted chocolate and cocoa powder.
Add remaining heavy cream, vanilla, and salt, whisking until velvety.
Bake at 225°C (440°F) for 30 minutes until top is dark caramelized and center wobbles.
Cool at room temperature for 3 hours. The chocolate truffle center remains ultra-rich and gooey.

title: Nutella & Hazelnut Praline Cheesecake
instructions: Press crushed chocolate biscuits and melted butter into cake pan.
Beat cream cheese and 200g Nutella until smooth and creamy.
Fold in whipped cream and half of the chopped roasted hazelnuts.
Spread evenly into crust and chill in refrigerator for 6 hours.
Warm remaining Nutella and drizzle across the top.
Garnish with toasted crushed hazelnuts and Ferrero Rocher quarters.

title: Matcha Green Tea Baked Cheesecake
instructions: Whisk matcha powder into 30ml warm cream until free of lumps.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and melted white chocolate until velvety.
Fold in vibrant green matcha cream and remaining cream.
Pour over buttery shortbread crust.
Bake in water bath at 150°C (300°F) for 55 minutes.
Chill thoroughly overnight; dust with fine matcha powder before slicing.

title: Salted Caramel Pretzel Cheesecake
instructions: Crush pretzels with butter and press into springform pan for a savory-sweet crust.
Beat cream cheese with 100ml salted caramel sauce until combined; fold in whipped cream.
Spoon filling over pretzel crust, swirl extra caramel ribbons through the batter.
Chill for 6 hours until firm.
Pour remaining salted caramel sauce over the set top and sprinkle crunchy pretzel pieces and flaky sea salt.

title: Fudge Brownies with Crinkly Paper Crust
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and butter together until silky.
Whisk sugars with milk-cornstarch slurry vigorously for 5 minutes until aerated and glossy (key to crinkly top).
Fold warm melted chocolate into sugar mixture.
Gently sift in flour, cocoa powder, and sea salt, folding until just combined.
Spread into an 8x8 lined baking tin.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 24 to 26 minutes until toothpick comes out with moist fudge crumbs.

title: Red Velvet Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Whisk buttermilk, oil, sugar, vanilla, and red color.
Sift in flour, cocoa powder, and salt.
Quickly mix baking soda with vinegar, fold bubbling foam immediately into batter.
Divide into two 8-inch cake tins and bake at 175°C for 28 minutes.
Cool completely and level tops, keeping cake crumbs for decoration.
Frost layers with tangy vanilla cream cheese frosting and coat sides with fine red velvet crumbs.

title: Classic Carrot Walnut Cake with Cinnamon Glaze
instructions: Whisk oil, brown sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and pinch of salt.
Stir in freshly grated carrots and toasted walnuts.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 35 to 40 minutes until skewer comes out clean.
Top with tangy cream cheese frosting and toasted walnut halves.

title: French Lemon Meringue Tart
instructions: Blind bake tart shell at 180°C until crisp and pale golden.
Cook lemon juice, zest, sugar, water, and cornstarch until bubbling and thick; whisk in cold butter until glossy.
Pour hot lemon curd into pre-baked tart shell and chill 2 hours.
Whip meringue until glossy, stiff marshmallow peaks form.
Pipe decorative domes across lemon curd and toast peaks with a kitchen torch.

title: Salted Caramel Dark Chocolate Ganache Tart
instructions: Bake chocolate tart shell and cool.
Pour salted caramel into base of tart shell and freeze 20 minutes to set.
Heat cream to a simmer, pour over chopped dark chocolate, let sit 2 minutes, and stir into mirror ganache.
Pour silky ganache over caramel layer up to rim.
Chill 2 hours; sprinkle flaky sea salt before serving.

title: Choux au Craquelin (Vanilla Cream Puffs)
instructions: Roll craquelin dough thin and cut into 2-inch circles; freeze.
Pipe choux pastry mounds onto parchment.
Top each mound with a frozen craquelin disc.
Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 25 minutes without opening oven door until puffed and crispy.
Poke bottom hole and fill generously with chilled vanilla pastry cream.

title: NYC Chunky Dark Choc Walnut Cookies
instructions: Cream cold butter cubes with sugars just until combined without over-creaming.
Stir in flours, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt.
Fold in dark chocolate chunks and walnuts.
Shape into large 150g rough balls without compacting.
Freeze balls for 30 minutes.
Bake at 205°C (400°F) for 11 minutes until outside is crisp and interior is molten gooey.

title: Parisian Raspberry Almond Macarons
instructions: Sift almond flour and powdered sugar twice.
Whip meringue with sugar into glossy stiff peaks.
Fold dry ingredients into meringue using macaronage technique until lava ribbon consistency.
Pipe 1.5-inch rounds onto silicone mat, rap tray on counter to release bubbles.
Rest 30 minutes until skin forms. Bake at 150°C for 14 minutes to develop ruffly feet.
Sandwich shells with tart seedless raspberry reduction.

title: Cardamom Rose Pistachio Tea Cake
instructions: Whisk yogurt, sugar, melted butter, rose water, and ground cardamom.
Fold in flour, almond meal, baking powder, and baking soda.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and top with slivered emerald pistachios.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 40 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Drizzle with delicate rose glaze and dried edible rose petals.

title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and butter together until completely glossy.
Stir in condensed milk slurry, vanilla, and espresso powder.
Sift in flour and fold gently until smooth.
Butter ramekins thoroughly and dust with cocoa powder.
Divide batter and bake at 200°C (400°F) for 10 to 12 minutes until sides are firm but center is soft.
Invert onto plate immediately; cut open to release flowing molten chocolate lava.

title: 18-Hour Slow Steeped Cold Brew

ingredients.name: Coarsely Ground Arabica Coffee Beans (Single Origin)

instructions: Combine coarse coffee grounds with cold filtered water in a French press or glass mason jar at a 1:8 ratio.
Stir gently to ensure all coffee grounds are fully saturated.
Seal airtight and steep in the refrigerator for 18 to 20 hours to extract chocolatey, low-acid flavors.
Strain concentrate through a fine mesh sieve lined with a paper coffee filter.
Serve concentrate diluted 1:1 with cold water or poured over clear ice blocks.

title: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Foam Cold Brew
instructions: Fill a tall glass with clear ice cubes and pour in rich cold brew coffee sweetened with 1 tbsp vanilla syrup.
In a separate small frothing pitcher, combine heavy cream, whole milk, and remaining vanilla syrup.
Froth with a handheld milk frother for 20 seconds until a velvety, micro-bubble cold foam forms.
Gently float the dense vanilla sweet cream foam over the top of the iced cold brew.
Sip without a straw to experience the contrast of icy crisp coffee through luscious velvet sweet cream.

title: Classic Affogato al Caffè

ingredients.name: Madagascar Vanilla Bean Gelato / Ice Cream
Freshly Pulled Hot Double Shot Espresso

instructions: Chill a dessert glass or rocks tumbler in the freezer for 15 minutes.
Place two firm scoops of dense vanilla bean gelato directly into the cold glass.
Pull a fresh, scalding hot double shot of rich espresso with thick crema.
Immediately pour the hot espresso directly over the mound of cold gelato.
Garnish with shaved dark chocolate and crunchy amaretti cookie crumbs. Serve with a spoon immediately.

title: Brass Davarah Filter Kaapi

ingredients.name: Fresh Ground Peaberry & Plantation A Coffee (85:15 Chicory)

instructions: Add coffee chicory powder to the upper compartment of a traditional stainless steel or brass drip filter.
Press powder gently with the pressing disc. Pour freshly boiled water over disc, close lid, and let brew 15 minutes for thick first decoction.
Boil full-fat milk until frothy.
In a brass tumbler, pour 3 tbsp hot first decoction and sugar to taste.
Pour scalding hot frothy milk from a height into tumbler.
Aerate by pouring back and forth between brass tumbler and davarah vessel to build a thick creamy froth cap. Serve steaming hot.

title: Spanish Cinnamon Iced Cortado
instructions: Layer condensed milk into the bottom of a glass tumbler (Cafe Bombón style).
Whisk hot espresso with a pinch of Ceylon cinnamon and pour over condensed milk.
Add crushed ice and top with cold whole milk.
Stir vigorously with a long spoon before drinking for a luscious spiced caramel coffee kick.

title: Brown Sugar Shaken Espresso with Oat Milk
instructions: In a cocktail shaker, combine hot espresso, dark brown sugar, cinnamon, and a full cup of ice cubes.
Shake vigorously for 20 seconds until frothy, chilled, and foamy.
Pour entire contents including ice into a tall glass.
Top gently with creamy barista oat milk and watch the caramel cascading ribbons form.

title: Vietnamese Iced Coffee (Cà Phê Sữa Đá)
instructions: Add condensed milk to bottom of heatproof glass.
Set a stainless steel Vietnamese Phin drip filter on top of glass; add coarse robusta coffee and screw filter press lightly.
Pour 20ml boiling water to bloom grounds for 30 seconds, then fill filter with 100ml boiling water.
Let coffee slowly drip through into condensed milk (approx. 4 to 5 minutes).
Stir hot coffee and condensed milk thoroughly until dissolved.
Pour over a tall glass packed with cracked ice.

title: Hazelnut Mocha Frappe with Whipped Cream
instructions: Add espresso, cold milk, hazelnut syrup, chocolate sauce, and ice into a high-speed blender.
Blend on high until smooth, thick, and slushy with no ice chunks.
Drizzle chocolate sauce inside the glass walls.
Pour blended frappe into glass and top generously with whipped cream swirl and chocolate curls.

title: Golden Turmeric Coconut Milk Latte
instructions: Whisk coconut milk, almond milk, turmeric, ginger, black pepper, and cinnamon in a small saucepan.
Simmer gently over low heat for 5 minutes without boiling to infuse flavors.
Strain through a fine tea sieve into a mug.
Stir in honey or maple syrup and froth top with a milk frother. Dust with cinnamon.

title: Iced Salted Caramel Macchiato
instructions: Add vanilla syrup to the bottom of a tall glass.
Fill glass with ice cubes, then pour cold whole milk over ice.
Slowly pour hot espresso directly over the center of the milk to create a stunning layered 'mark' (macchiato).
Finish with a crosshatch pattern of buttery salted caramel drizzle on top.

title: Brown Sugar Tiger Boba Milk Tea

ingredients.name: Fresh Cold Whole Milk or Oat Milk

instructions: Boil tapioca pearls in water for 20 minutes; cover and rest for 20 minutes until tender and chewy.
Simmer drained warm pearls with dark brown sugar and water until syrup thickens into a glossy glaze.
Spoon warm glossy boba into bottom of glass. Swirl and tilt glass horizontally to paint 'tiger stripes' on the glass walls.
Add ice cubes gently to hold the syrup in place.
Pour cold milk over ice; stir with a wide boba straw before sipping.

title: Taro Coconut Boba Milk Tea

ingredients.name: Taro Powder or Fresh Steamed Taro Puree

instructions: Blend taro puree/powder with warm jasmine tea, coconut milk, and condensed milk until smooth and lavender purple.
Place warm chewy boba pearls into bottom of glass.
Add ice cubes and pour creamy taro coconut tea over boba.
Top with a splash of evaporated coconut cream.

title: Ceremonial Iced Matcha Latte with Oat Milk
instructions: Sift matcha powder through a fine mesh strainer into a chawan bowl.
Add 80°C water and whisk vigorously in 'W' motions using a bamboo chasen whisk until emerald froth forms.
Fill glass with ice and pour cold oat milk sweetened with agave syrup.
Slowly pour vibrant green matcha foam over oat milk for a picture-perfect two-tone layer.

title: Fresh Peach Mint Iced Tea

ingredients.name: English Breakfast or Nilgiri Black Tea

instructions: Simmer sliced peaches with sugar and water for 8 minutes; mash gently and strain into fresh peach nectar.
Brew black tea in 500ml boiling water for 4 minutes; discard tea bags and chill tea.
Muddle fresh mint leaves with lemon juice in a pitcher.
Add peach nectar, chilled black tea, and generous ice cubes.
Stir well and serve garnished with fresh peach slices and mint sprigs.

title: Hibiscus Berry Sparkler Iced Tea
instructions: Boil dried hibiscus flowers with water and sugar for 5 minutes; strain and chill ruby red concentrate.
Muddle fresh berries and lime juice in a highball glass.
Fill glass with ice and pour 100ml cold hibiscus infusion.
Top with chilled sparkling club soda for an effervescent floral sparkle.

title: Lemongrass Ginger Herbal Detox Brew
instructions: Bruise lemongrass stalks with rolling pin to release aromatic oils.
Bring water to boil with lemongrass and ginger; simmer on low heat for 7 minutes.
Turn off heat, add mint leaves, and steep covered for 3 minutes.
Strain into a warm cup, stir in raw honey, and enjoy soothing citrus warmth.

title: Kashmiri Noon Chai (Pink Salted Tea)
instructions: Boil tea leaves and baking soda in water until reduced to deep red concentrate (approx. 15 mins).
Shock tea by splashing cold ice water and aerating vigorously with a ladle until burgundy-red.
Strain brewed concentrate and return to pan.
Pour in whole milk—watch the tea magically turn into a dusky baby pink color.
Season with rock salt and crushed cardamom. Simmer 3 minutes.
Serve hot garnished with chopped slivered almonds and pistachios.

title: Irani Chai with Bun Mawa
instructions: In one pot, brew tea leaves, sugar, and water on 'dum' (sealed with dough or tight lid) over slow heat for 25 minutes to make a potent black decoction.
In a second pot, slowly simmer milk with khoya (mawa), crushed cardamom, and condensed milk until thickened and reduced by 30%.
To serve authentic Irani style: pour half a cup of thick mawa-infused milk.
Top with hot dark tea decoction without stirring to create a dual-tone cup. Serve with warm butter bun.
