instructions: Swirl thin batter on a hot buttered crepe pan until paper-thin; cook 1 minute and flip for 30 seconds.
Spread warm Nutella over half the crepe, layer fresh sliced strawberries.
Fold in half and then into quarters (triangle envelope).
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with whipped cream.

title: Savory Mushroom & Gruyère French Crepes
instructions: Place warm crepe on griddle, sprinkle Gruyère cheese, warm thyme mushrooms, and spoonful of bechamel.
Fold edges inward into a neat square pocket.
Cook until cheese melts and base is crisp.

title: Brioche French Toast with Cinnamon & Berries

ingredients.name: Thick Cut Slices of Butter Brioche Loaf (1.5-inch)
Custard Soak (Milk, Vanilla, Cinnamon, Nutmeg, Maple)

instructions: Soak thick brioche slices in vanilla cinnamon custard for 30 seconds per side.
Pan-fry in foaming salted butter on medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown, caramelized, and custardy in the center.
Serve topped with fresh berries, a cloud of powdered sugar, and warm maple syrup.

title: Sizzling Chocolate Walnut Brownie with Ice Cream
instructions: Heat cast iron sizzler plate over open flame until smoking hot; transfer onto wooden base.
Place a small dot of butter on hot iron.
Immediately set warm walnut brownie in the center.
Crown with a firm scoop of cold vanilla ice cream.
Pour hot dark chocolate sauce around brownie and iron plate table-side.
Watch sauce bubble furiously, sizzling and caramelizing into chewy toffee edges as chocolate steam fills the room.

title: Churros Bites with Warm Dark Chocolate Ganache
instructions: Deep fry bite-sized star-piped churro pieces until crispy golden.
Toss in cinnamon sugar while smoking hot.
Serve in a cone with a warm pot of dark chocolate ganache.

title: Hyderabadi Dum Chicken Biryani

ingredients.name: Aged Long-Grain Basmati Rice (70% parboiled with whole spices)
Ginger-Garlic Paste, Shahi Jeera, Mint & Coriander
Saffron Infused Milk & Pure Desi Ghee

instructions: Marinate raw chicken with yogurt, biryani masala, ginger-garlic paste, half the birista, mint, coriander, and ghee for 2 hours.
Boil basmati rice with whole spices (cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf, star anise) until 70% cooked; drain.
In a heavy-bottomed handi, layer marinated raw chicken at the bottom.
Cover chicken with parboiled fragrant basmati rice.
Top with remaining golden birista, fresh mint leaves, saffron milk, and generous ladles of hot ghee.
Seal handi rim tightly with wheat flour dough and heavy lid.
Cook on high heat for 10 minutes, then place on a hot iron tawa over low heat on 'dum' for 35 minutes.
Rest 15 minutes. Unseal to release aromatic saffron steam; gently lift from bottom to serve layers with mirchi ka salan.

title: Awadhi Mutton Dum Biryani (Lucknowi)

ingredients.name: Rich Mutton Yakhni (Stock with Potli spices)
Saffron infused in warm milk with Ghee

instructions: Simmer mutton with whole spices (mace, nutmeg, cardamom, rose petals) in water until tender, creating rich aromatic yakhni stock.
Parboil basmati rice directly in the seasoned yakhni stock.
Layer tender cooked mutton in ghee, cover with fragrant parboiled rice, saffron milk, and drops of kewra and meetha ittr.
Dum cook sealed with dough for 25 minutes on low heat for exquisite Nawabi elegance.

title: Kolkata Mutton Biryani with Potato & Egg

ingredients.name: Large Halved Potatoes (marinated in saffron & fried golden)

instructions: Parboil halved potatoes in turmeric salt water, then fry in ghee until crusty golden exterior forms.
Cook mutton in aromatic yakhni until meltingly tender.
Layer mutton, large melt-in-mouth golden potatoes, boiled eggs, and parboiled rice.
Drizzle saffron milk, ghee, and meetha attar.
Dum cook covered for 25 minutes. The velvety, meat-flavor-infused potato is the undisputed star of Kolkata biryani.

title: Chettinad Pepper Chicken Fry
instructions: Dry roast peppercorns, coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, and kalpasi; grind into a coarse dark Chettinad masala.
Heat gingelly oil, splutter mustard and fennel seeds, and toss in lots of fresh curry leaves.
Sauté sambhar shallots until deep golden.
Add chicken, turmeric, and ginger-garlic paste; cook until moisture evaporates.
Add ground Chettinad pepper masala and roast on medium-low heat for 15 minutes until chicken is dark, deeply spiced, and dry-roasted (sukka style).
Finish with a shower of extra crushed black pepper and fresh curry leaves.

title: Malabar Fish Curry with Coconut Milk & Kudampuli
instructions: In an earthen clay pot (meen chatti), sauté shallots, ginger, and slit green chillies in fragrant coconut oil.
Add chili powder, coriander, and turmeric; cook until raw smell disappears.
Add thin coconut milk, soaked smoky kudampuli pieces, and its soaking water.
Bring to a gentle boil, then slip in fresh kingfish steaks.
Simmer for 10 minutes until fish is cooked through and flaky.
Pour in thick coconut cream, swirl the pot (do not stir with spoon to avoid breaking fish).
Tempered with mustard seeds, shallots, and crisp curry leaves in coconut oil. Rest for 2 hours before serving with Kerala red rice.

title: Goan Prawn Balchão (Fiery Pickled Prawns)

ingredients.name: Goan Toddy Vinegar / Apple Cider Vinegar
Kashmiri Dried Chillies, Cumin, Mustard, Cloves

instructions: Grind dried Kashmiri chillies with whole spices in pure vinegar into a smooth crimson paste (no water).
Slowly brown minced onions in oil for 15 minutes until dark caramelized jam.
Add ginger, garlic, and fiery red spice-vinegar paste; fry until oil separates.
Toss in prawns with a pinch of sugar and salt, cooking for 5 minutes until prawns curl and sauce thickens into a glossy pickle consistency.
Serve hot with warm crusty Goan poee or steamed rice.

title: Bengali Shorshe Maach (Mustard Hilsa / Rohu)

ingredients.name: Rohu, Katla or Hilsa Fish Steaks
Yellow and Black Mustard Seeds (ground with green chillies & salt)

instructions: Marinate fish steaks with turmeric and salt; lightly flash-fry in smoking hot mustard oil for 1 minute per side; remove.
In the same pungent oil, splutter nigella seeds and slit green chillies.
Whisk freshly ground mustard paste with warm water and turmeric; strain into pan.
Simmer for 3 minutes, then gently slide fish steaks into the sauce.
Cover and cook on low for 6 minutes.
Finish with a generous swirl of raw pungent mustard oil and more slit chillies.
Serve with steaming hot fragrant Gobindobhog or Basmati rice.

title: Rajasthani Laal Maas with Mathania Chillies

ingredients.name: Garlic Paste and Whole Khada Masala

instructions: Heat desi ghee in a heavy pot; add whole spices (black cardamom, cloves, cinnamon).
Brown onions until deep golden; add garlic and mutton pieces.
Bhunno (sear) mutton in ghee for 15 minutes until deeply browned.
Stir in pureed vibrant red Mathania chilli paste and whisked curd.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles or slow simmer on low heat for 50 minutes until meat falls off bone.
Perform Dhungar: place a small steel bowl on gravy with red hot charcoal, drop a clove and ghee, and immediately seal lid for 5 minutes for royal hunting lodge smokiness.

title: Traditional Gujarati Dal Dhokli

ingredients.name: Toor Dal (Pigeon Peas, pressure cooked & churned)
Mustard, Cumin, Hing, Curry Leaves & Ghee Vaghar

instructions: Roll seasoned wheat dough thin, cut into diamond shapes with a pastry wheel.
Bring cooked toor dal to a rolling boil with jaggery, kokum, peanuts, and spices into a sweet, sour, and spicy soup.
Drop cut dhokli pieces one-by-one into the boiling dal.
Simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until dhokli is cooked through and absorbs flavors.
Temper with mustard, cumin, hing, and curry leaves in hot ghee; pour sizzling vaghar over dal.
Garnish with coriander and serve hot with extra ghee.

title: Authentic Kashmiri Rogan Josh

ingredients.name: Ratanjot (Alkanet root) infused in warm oil

instructions: Heat mustard oil until smoking, cool slightly, and add hing and whole spices.
Sear mutton in oil until lightly browned.
Add whisked yogurt gradually while stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Add fennel powder, dry ginger powder, and Kashmiri red chili paste.
Pour in warm water, add ratanjot extract for glorious crimson red oil (rogan).
Pressure cook for 4 whistles until meat is spoon-tender.
Serve with steamed rice.

title: Mangalorean Kori Rotti (Chicken Curry with Rice Wafers)

ingredients.name: Fresh Grated Coconut (roasted with Byadgi chillies & spices)

instructions: Roast Byadgi chillies, coriander, cumin, pepper, and coconut; grind into a smooth Kundapur masala.
Cook chicken with onion, tamarind, and ground masala until tender.
Stir in rich coconut milk and simmer into a thin, highly flavorful red curry (Gassi).
To eat: crush crispy dry rice wafers (rotti) on a plate, pour generous ladles of piping hot curry over wafers until they soften and soak up the spicy coconut gravy.

title: Amritsari Crispy Ajwain Fish Fry with Chutney

ingredients.name: Firm Fish Fillets (Singhara or Sole, cut into fingers)

instructions: Marinate fish fingers in lemon juice, garlic paste, red chili, and salt for 15 minutes.
Coat in a light batter of besan, rice flour, and plenty of aromatic crushed ajwain.
Deep fry in hot mustard oil until shatteringly crisp on the outside and flaky white inside.
Drain, toss in tangy chaat masala, and serve with onion rings and radish laccha.

title: High-Protein Soya Chaap Tikka Masala

ingredients.name: Soya Chaap Sticks (unrolled & cut into bite chunks)

instructions: Fry soya chaap chunks until layers puff open; marinate in tandoori yogurt marinade and char in oven/pan.
Sauté peppers and onions in rich tomato onion gravy.
Toss in charred soya chaap chunks, simmering for 5 minutes so layers soak in gravy.
Finish with kasuri methi and butter.

title: High-Protein Grilled Paneer Steak in Makhani

ingredients.name: Thick Low-Fat / Fresh Malai Paneer Slab (200g)
Tandoori Spices (Kashmiri mirch, garam masala, yogurt)

instructions: Marinate thick paneer block and grill in grill pan for 3 minutes per side until charred grill marks form.
Warm rich silky makhani gravy.
Plate sautéed baby greens, pour a pool of hot makhani sauce, and rest the charred paneer steak in the center.
Garnish with micro-greens and ginger juliennes.

title: High-Protein Chicken Breast in Green Herb Gravy

ingredients.name: Lean Chicken Breast (cubed or whole fillet)
Fresh Herb Gravy (Spinach, Coriander, Mint, Green Chillies)

instructions: Sear chicken breast cubes in olive oil with garlic and cumin until golden.
Pour in vibrant emerald green spinach-coriander-mint puree and yogurt.
Simmer gently for 8 minutes until chicken is tender and juicy.
Season with black pepper and lemon juice for a lean, high-protein powerhouse meal.
